dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Steady, symmetrical geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the wide anterior section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins; a minor asymmetrical indentation is visible on the lower-right edge relative to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity and low specular interference.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of diffuse, faint greyish-pixel clusters located on the mid-right and lower-left dorsal surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the white baseline and localized grey mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct diagonal linear mark on the right dorsal flank; faint circular contrast disruption near the central longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent diagonal linear mark on the right side of the dorsal plane.
